rules: HalfWaveTimer runs at half the actual wave duration.
Use integer permanent RunData source stat, not live temporary/linked stat values.
floor(maximum zero, source * percentage / chunk size) determines chunks.
Divide removed and added raw deltas by their positive stat-gain multipliers, rounding independently; TempStats then applies normal gains.
Snapshot the conversion once. Later source-stat gains are not reconverted.
Native wave-end TempStats reset removes the conversion before shop. Retry restores the pre-conversion checkpoint.
